sentences.en: Welcome to Hidden Brain, I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听Hidden Brain，我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: This week we're going to bring you a conversation I had in front of a live audience with Richard
sentences.zh: 本周我们将为您带来我与理查德·泰勒

sentences.en: Thaler, taped on Halloween at the Willard Intercontinental Hotel in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 在华盛顿特区威拉德洲际酒店万圣节现场录制的一场对话。

sentences.en: Richard is a professor of behavioral sciences and economics at the University of Chicago
sentences.zh: 理查德是芝加哥大学的行为科学与经济学教授，

sentences.en: and is a well-known author.
sentences.zh: 也是一位知名的作家。

sentences.en: His latest book is called Misbehaving,
sentences.zh: 他的最新著作名为《轻率行为》，

sentences.en: The Making of Behavioral Economics.
sentences.zh: 副标题是《行为经济学的成型》。

sentences.en: I want to start by asking Richard
sentences.zh: 我想先问理查德

sentences.en: a real softball question.
sentences.zh: 一个非常简单的问题。

sentences.en: You have a friend, whose name is Daniel Kahneman,
sentences.zh: 你有一个朋友，名叫丹尼尔·卡尼曼，

sentences.en: he won the Nobel Prize in economics some years ago, world-famous psychologist,
sentences.zh: 他几年前获得了诺贝尔经济学奖，是一位世界闻名的心理学家、

sentences.en: brilliant author, and Danny Kahneman was once asked to describe Richard Thaler
sentences.zh: 杰出的作家，有一次丹尼·卡尼曼被要求向一位记者

sentences.en: to a journalist, and he said that Richard's dominant characteristic,
sentences.zh: 描述理查德·泰勒，他说理查德最主要的特征，

sentences.en: the thing that makes him stand out, is that Richard is lazy.
sentences.zh: 也就是让他脱颖而出的地方，是理查德很懒。

sentences.en: Can you tell me, Richard, why Danny said that, and also why he insists that this was a compliment?
sentences.zh: 理查德，你能告诉我丹尼为什么这么说，以及为什么他坚称这其实是个赞美吗？

sentences.en: What's worse is, A, Danny is my best friend, and B, he said this was my best quality.
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，第一，丹尼是我最好的朋友；第二，他说这是我最好的品质。

sentences.en: To this day, Danny defends this, and he defends, A, that it's true, and B,
sentences.zh: 直到今天，丹尼还在为这个说法辩护，他坚称，第一，这是真的；第二，

sentences.en: that it's a compliment, because he says that it means I'm only willing to work on things
sentences.zh: 这是一个赞美，因为他说这意味着我只愿意把时间花在

sentences.en: that are important.
sentences.zh: 重要的事情上。

sentences.en: The truth is, I'm only willing to work on things that are fun.
sentences.zh: 事实是，我只愿意把时间花在有趣的事情上。

sentences.en: And that's why I'm here today, because I think we're going to have fun.
sentences.zh: 这也是我今天来到这里的原因，因为我觉得我们会度过一段有趣的时光。

sentences.en: I think that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 我想完全是这样。

sentences.en: So I first started talking to Richard maybe about 10 years ago.
sentences.zh: 所以，我和理查德大约在10年前开始交流。

sentences.en: Let me just ask you to give us a very short introduction.
sentences.zh: 请允许我先请你为我们做一个简短的介绍。

sentences.en: What is behavioral economics, and why has it made such a splash,
sentences.zh: 什么是行为经济学，为什么它在过去15到20年里引起了如此大的轰动，

sentences.en: or why has it been so controversial over the last 15 or 20 years?
sentences.zh: 或者说为什么它一直如此具有争议？

sentences.en: How is it different than garden-variety economics?
sentences.zh: 它与传统经济学有什么不同？

sentences.en: You know, probably sometime in your distant past,
sentences.zh: 你知道，可能在你们遥远的过去某个时候，

sentences.en: all of you have had a class in economics,
sentences.zh: 你们所有人都上过经济学课程，

sentences.en: and you know that standard economics assumes that people are highly rational creatures,
sentences.zh: 而且你知道标准经济学假设人们是高度理性的生物，

sentences.en: capable of complex calculations, devoid of emotion,
sentences.zh: 能够进行复杂的计算，没有情感，

sentences.en: never having any self-control problems,
sentences.zh: 从没有自控力问题，

sentences.en: and they're complete jerks.
sentences.zh: 而且他们是彻头彻尾的混蛋。

sentences.en: So I call these fictional creatures econs.
sentences.zh: 所以我把这些虚构的生物叫做“理性的经济人”（econs）。

sentences.en: That's short for homo economicus, the Latin term.
sentences.zh: 这是拉丁语 homo economicus 的简称。

sentences.en: And I believe that for the last 50 or 60 years,
sentences.zh: 我相信在过去的50或60年里，

sentences.en: economists have devoted themselves to studying fictional creatures.
sentences.zh: 经济学家们一直致力于研究虚构的生物。

sentences.en: They might as well be studying unicorns, because there are no econs.
sentences.zh: 他们还不如去研究独角兽，因为根本没有“理性的经济人”。

sentences.en: Well, there are a few economists I know who are close,
sentences.zh: 好吧，我认识的一些经济学家很接近这种设定，

sentences.en: but basically they don't exiSt.
sentences.zh: 但基本上他们并不存在。

sentences.en: And so we have very fancy models of fictional creatures.
sentences.zh: 所以我们拥有针对虚构生物的非常花哨的模型。

sentences.en: And the people I know have trouble figuring out how to divide a check
sentences.zh: 而我认识的人在面对如何分账单时却遇到了麻烦，

sentences.en: if there are more than three people.
sentences.zh: 如果人数超过三人的话。

sentences.en: Occasionally, just occasionally, overeat or overdrink,
sentences.zh: 他们偶尔、只是偶尔会吃多或喝多，

sentences.en: have trouble saving for retirement.
sentences.zh: 在为退休储蓄时遇到困难。

sentences.en: And contrary to economic theory,
sentences.zh: 而且与经济学理论相反，

sentences.en: some, at least, are willing to donate to national public radio,
sentences.zh: 至少有些人愿意向国家公共广播电台捐款，

sentences.en: which any economist will tell you is a completely irrational thing to do,
sentences.zh: 任何经济学家都会告诉你这是一种完全不理性的做法，

sentences.en: because you can listen to it for free.
sentences.zh: 因为你可以免费收听。

sentences.en: So, when I first started talking to Richard about 10 years ago,
sentences.zh: 所以，大约10年前我第一次开始和理查德交谈时，

sentences.en: it was for a topic that was called mental accounting.
sentences.zh: 谈论的是一个叫做“心理账户”的主题。

sentences.en: And Richard explained to me that mental accounting is something
sentences.zh: 理查德向我解释说，心理账户是我们

sentences.en: that we all do in everyday life.
sentences.zh: 在日常生活中都会做的事情。

sentences.en: And one of the things that I noticed is as soon as Richard started talking,
sentences.zh: 我注意到的一件事是，理查德刚一开口说话，

sentences.en: I started thinking of examples from my own life
sentences.zh: 我就开始联想到我自己的生活中的例子，

sentences.en: where mental accounting was playing a really, really big role.
sentences.zh: 在这些例子中，心理账户发挥了非常非常大的作用。

sentences.en: Let me just start by having you tell us what mental accounting is, Richard.
sentences.zh: 理查德，请你先给我们讲讲什么是心理账户。

sentences.en: So, a basic concept of economics is that money is fungible,
sentences.zh: 经济学的一个基本概念是金钱是同质可替代的，

sentences.en: which means that there are no labels on it.
sentences.zh: 这意味着它上面没有标签。

sentences.en: And there's a video of Dustin Hoffman and Gene Hackman talking.
sentences.zh: 有一段达斯汀·霍夫曼和吉恩·哈克曼交谈的视频。

sentences.en: And Gene Hackman's telling this story about when they were young actors.
sentences.zh: 吉恩·哈克曼在讲一个关于他们年轻时做演员的故事。

sentences.en: Hackman goes to visit Dustin Hoffman in his little apartment in Pasadena.
sentences.zh: 哈克曼去帕萨迪纳拜访达斯汀·霍夫曼的小公寓。

sentences.en: Dustin Hoffman has asked him to borrow some money.
sentences.zh: 达斯汀·霍夫曼向他借钱。

sentences.en: And then Hackman goes into his kitchen,
sentences.zh: 然后哈克曼走进厨房，

sentences.en: and he sees these mason jars that have labels on them.
sentences.zh: 他看到了贴着标签的梅森罐。

sentences.en: And one is rent, and one is utility.
sentences.zh: 一个是房租，一个是水电费。

sentences.en: And there was nothing in the jar labeled food.
sentences.zh: 而那个贴着“食物”标签的罐子里空无一物。

sentences.en: And so, Hackman says, you don't need any money.
sentences.zh: 于是哈克曼说，你不需要钱啊。

sentences.en: You've got lots of money in all these jars.
sentences.zh: 你所有这些罐子里有那么多的钱。

sentences.en: And Hoffman says, yeah, but there's nothing in the food jar.
sentences.zh: 霍夫曼说，对，但是食物罐里没有东西。

sentences.en: And so, that's mental accounting, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是心理账户，对吧？

sentences.en: And it used to be, like, certainly in my grandparents' generation,
sentences.zh: 过去，比如肯定是在我祖父母那一代人中，

sentences.en: that that's literally how people did it.
sentences.zh: 人们真的是那样做的。

sentences.en: But we still do it mostly in our heads.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在仍然主要在脑海中这样做。

sentences.en: And it can make us do all kinds of funny things.
sentences.zh: 这会让我们做出各种各样滑稽的事情。

sentences.en: So, one of the things that's happened over the years
sentences.zh: 这些年发生的事情之一，

sentences.en: is that Richard has actually played a psychotherapist for many people
sentences.zh: 就是理查德实际上扮演了许多人的心理治疗师，

sentences.en: who come to him with their economics probleMs.
sentences.zh: 这些人带着他们的经济问题来找他。

sentences.en: And I'm actually going to do the same thing here.
sentences.zh: 我实际上也打算在这里做同样的事情。

sentences.en: One of the things I've noticed about myself
sentences.zh: 我注意到自己的一点是，

sentences.en: is that my wife and I, we share our finances.
sentences.zh: 我和我妻子共享财务。

sentences.en: So, we have a joint checking account.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有一个共同的支票账户。

sentences.en: We sort of draw from the same pool of money.
sentences.zh: 我们基本上从同一笔资金池里取钱。

sentences.en: But I've noticed that when I go to restaurants,
sentences.zh: 但我注意到，当我走进餐厅时，

sentences.en: I really like it when my wife pulls out her credit card
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢我妻子掏出她的信用卡

sentences.en: and pays for the bill.
sentences.zh: 来支付账单。

sentences.en: Now, I am effectively still paying for it.
sentences.zh: 现在，实际上依然是我在付钱。

sentences.en: But it significantly increases my satisfaction with the meal
sentences.zh: 但这大大增强了我对这顿饭的满意度，

sentences.en: not to have to pull out my own credit card.
sentences.zh: 因为不用掏出我自己的信用卡。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, all right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So, here's something that would be even better.
sentences.zh: 所以，这里有一个甚至更好的办法。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: Assuming you and your wife trust one another.
sentences.zh: 假设你和你的妻子彼此信任。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I recommend that you each get separate checking accounts.
sentences.zh: 我建议你们各自开设独立的支票账户。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: You can still have a...
sentences.zh: 你仍然可以拥有一个……

sentences.en: My wife and I have this arrangement.
sentences.zh: 我和我妻子就是这样安排的。

sentences.en: So, we each have a separate checking account
sentences.zh: 所以，我们各自有一个独立的支票账户

sentences.en: and a joint checking account.
sentences.zh: 和一个共同的支票账户。

sentences.en: And splurges,
sentences.zh: 至于挥霍，

sentences.en: if I buy myself a new set of golf clubs that I desperately need...
sentences.zh: 如果我给自己买了一套我极其需要的全新高尔夫球杆……

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Or she buys her fourth camera
sentences.zh: 或者她买了她的第四台相机，

sentences.en: because she travels the world taking pictures,
sentences.zh: 因为她周游世界拍照，

sentences.en: I don't see that.
sentences.zh: 我是看不见的。

sentences.en: So, the splurges come out of your individual checking account.
sentences.zh: 所以，挥霍的钱是从你们各自独立的支票账户里出的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And gifts.
sentences.zh: 还有礼物。

sentences.en: So, if your wife picks up the tab,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你的妻子买单，

sentences.en: it will come from her account.
sentences.zh: 这笔钱将从她的账户中扣除。

sentences.en: That's even better.
sentences.zh: 那甚至更好。

sentences.en: Even better.
sentences.zh: 更好。

sentences.en: That's really a good idea.
sentences.zh: 这真是一个好主意。

sentences.en: And, I mean, this is a recipe for marital harmony.
sentences.zh: 而且，我的意思是，这是维系婚姻和谐的秘诀。

sentences.en: One of the findings of mental accounting
sentences.zh: 心理账户的一个发现是，

sentences.en: is that people keep tabs in their head
sentences.zh: 人们在脑海中记着账，

sentences.en: about how much money they need to make
sentences.zh: 关于他们需要在年度、月度、

sentences.en: on an annual basis or a monthly basis
sentences.zh: 甚至是某些时候的日度基础上

sentences.en: or even sometimes on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 赚取多少钱。

sentences.en: And one of the things that you explained to me
sentences.zh: 你向我解释的事情之一

sentences.en: was this might explain why it's sometimes difficult
sentences.zh: 就是这或许可以解释为什么有时在下雨的夜晚

sentences.en: to catch a cab on a rainy evening.
sentences.zh: 很难拦到出租车。

sentences.en: Can you tell us why mental accounting
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们为什么心理账户

sentences.en: might make it harder for us to catch cabs on rainy evenings?
sentences.zh: 可能会让我们在下雨的夜晚更难拦到出租车吗？

sentences.en: So, this is a study that some friends of mine
sentences.zh: 所以，这是我和一些朋友

sentences.en: and I did a long time ago in New York
sentences.zh: 很久以前在纽约做的一项研究，

sentences.en: and we were taking a lot of cabs
sentences.zh: 当时我们经常坐出租车，

sentences.en: and we would talk to the cab drivers
sentences.zh: 我们会和出租车司机交谈，

sentences.en: and we would ask them,
sentences.zh: 我们会问他们，

sentences.en: how do you decide how long to work?
sentences.zh: 你们是如何决定工作多长时间的？

sentences.en: They rent the cab for 12 hours,
sentences.zh: 他们租出租车12个小时，

sentences.en: which is a long time to drive in Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 在曼哈顿开车这是一段很长的时间。

sentences.en: And then they have to take it back within the 12 hours.
sentences.zh: 然后他们必须在12小时内把车还回去。

sentences.en: And a lot of them would say,
sentences.zh: 许多人会说，

sentences.en: well, what we do is I set a target.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们做的是设定一个目标。

sentences.en: So, renting the cab cost me 100 bucks
sentences.zh: 所以，租出租车花了我100块钱，

sentences.en: and then I have to fill the tank up.
sentences.zh: 然后我还得把油箱加满。

sentences.en: Let's say that's another 25 bucks.
sentences.zh: 假设那是另外25块钱。

sentences.en: So, I want to make a certain amount above that,
sentences.zh: 所以我想在此基础上再赚取一定的金额，
比方说100美元。

sentences.en: And when I hit that, I go home.
sentences.zh: 当我达到这个目标时，我就回家。

sentences.en: Now, an implication of that is
sentences.zh: 现在，由此产生的一个推论是，

sentences.en: on days like rainy days
sentences.zh: 在像下雨天这样

sentences.en: where there's lots of demand,
sentences.zh: 需求量很大的日子里，

sentences.en: they hit their target early and they go home.
sentences.zh: 他们会提前达到目标然后回家。

sentences.en: Now, what would an econ do?
sentences.zh: 那么，理性的经济人会怎么做？

sentences.en: An econ would drive more on the busy days.
sentences.zh: 理性的经济人会在生意忙碌的日子里开更多时间的车。

sentences.en: And on the sunny day
sentences.zh: 而在阳光明媚的日子里

sentences.en: when nobody needs a cab because they're walking,
sentences.zh: 当人们步行出行、不需要乘出租车时

sentences.en: he would go out for a walk himself.
sentences.zh: 他自己就会出去散步。

sentences.en: Again, if we go back to getting along with your spouse,
sentences.zh: 话说回来，如果我们回到与配偶相处的话题上

sentences.en: imagine the guy comes home at 2 in the afternoon
sentences.zh: 想象一下，有个男人下午两点回到家

sentences.en: and his wife says,
sentences.zh: 他的妻子说

sentences.en: how come you're home so early?
sentences.zh: 你怎么这么早就回家了？

sentences.en: And he says, because I didn't make any money.
sentences.zh: 他说，因为我没赚到钱。

sentences.en: I mean, this is not going to go over well.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这可说不过去。

sentences.en: No, it won't.
sentences.zh: 是的，说不过去。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, you've got to go out there
sentences.zh: 所以，你必须出门

sentences.en: and drive around for three more hours
sentences.zh: 再到处开车兜风三个小时

sentences.en: burning gas, not making any money.
sentences.zh: 耗费汽油，却一分钱也没赚到。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But the interesting thing, of course,
sentences.zh: 但当然，有趣的是

sentences.en: is that standard economics would predict
sentences.zh: 标准经济学原本会预测

sentences.en: that people actually would act rationally,
sentences.zh: 人们实际上会理性行事

sentences.en: that they would actually work more
sentences.zh: 也就是说，他们实际上会多工作

sentences.en: when the demand is higher
sentences.zh: 当需求更高的时候

sentences.en: and they would work less
sentences.zh: 而他们会少工作

sentences.en: when the demand is lower.
sentences.zh: 当需求更低的时候。

sentences.en: And, of course, what we find is exactly the opposite.
sentences.zh: 然而，当然，我们发现的情况却完全相反。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: One of the interesting implications of mental accounting
sentences.zh: 心理账户的一个有趣影响

sentences.en: is that where the source of people's money
sentences.zh: 在于人们资金的来源

sentences.en: ends up changing how they spend the money.
sentences.zh: 最终会改变他们花钱的方式。

sentences.en: So, there was a study by Viviana Zelizer,
sentences.zh: 所以，维维安·泽利泽曾做过一项研究

sentences.en: I believe, at Princeton University,
sentences.zh: 如果我没记错的话，是在普林斯顿大学

sentences.en: looking at prostitutes in Oslo.
sentences.zh: 研究对象是奥斯陆的性工作者。

sentences.en: And what she found is that the sex workers
sentences.zh: 她发现的是，这些性工作者

sentences.en: were willing to spend money that they received
sentences.zh: 愿意把她们收到的钱花在

sentences.en: in the form of welfare checks
sentences.zh: 以福利救济金形式发放的资金

sentences.en: or other kinds of subsidies
sentences.zh: 或其他种类的补贴上

sentences.en: on things like rent and important things.
sentences.zh: 花在房租和重要事情上。

sentences.en: But they spent the money that they earned from sex work.
sentences.zh: 但她们通过性工作赚来的钱

sentences.en: They were far more likely to spend that
sentences.zh: 她们更有可能把这笔钱花在

sentences.en: on drugs and alcohol,
sentences.zh: 毒品和酒精上

sentences.en: that the source of the money
sentences.zh: 也就是说，钱的来源

sentences.en: determines how you actually spend the money.
sentences.zh: 决定了你实际上会如何花这笔钱。

sentences.en: I saw a clip from a video.
sentences.zh: 我看到了一段视频剪辑。
